references.text: God promised to give Caleb, son of Jephunneh, the land he had scouted because he followed the Lord with all his heart.
Caleb, son of Jephunneh, was one of the spies sent out from the tribe of Judah.
Caleb reminds Joshua of the promise the Lord made through Moses and asks for Hebron as his inheritance.
Hebron, also called Kiriath-Arba after the ancestor of the Anakites, was given to the descendants of Aaron, while the fields and villages were given to Caleb.
Moses confirms that Caleb will receive the land he has walked through as his inheritance.
Hebron was given to Caleb just as Moses had said, and he drove out the three sons of Anak from there.
Hebron was also called Kiriath-Arba, and this was the place where Sarah died.
The Anakites lived in Hebron, and the spies saw them when they explored the land.
